channel.title: Dennis Hilk — Blog (English)
channel.description: Linux, open source, retro computing, weird hardware and personal projects by Dennis Hilk.

item.title: Configure Dunst: Linux desktop notifications explained
item.description: Understand Dunst with my Cthulhu colours, notification position, timeouts and rules. Test local notifications and troubleshoot common problems.

item.title: Configure Kitty: fonts, colours, transparency and terminal images
item.description: Configure Kitty step by step with my Gruvnode settings: fonts, colours, transparency and terminal images. Start with a separate local test file.

item.title: Picom on X11: understand transparency, shadows and errors
item.description: Picom for X11 explained using my Gruvnode profile: Kitty transparency, shadows and common errors. Try a separate configuration with a clear way back.

item.title: Configure Rofi: an app launcher, shortcuts and custom themes
item.description: Rofi for beginners: understand drun and run, read my Gruvnode theme and test a separate Rasi file. Includes XMonad shortcuts and troubleshooting.

item.title: fish for beginners: suggestions, aliases and configuration
item.description: Understand the fish shell: suggestions, Tab completion, aliases, abbreviations and config.fish. Includes small exercises linked to my NixOS setup.

item.title: journalctl for beginners: find Linux errors in system logs
item.description: Narrow down Linux problems with journalctl: filter by boot, time, service and priority. Includes a local test message and guidance for sharing logs.

item.title: Linux drives explained: UUIDs, mountpoints and permissions
item.description: Understand Linux mounts: UUIDs, mountpoints, ext4 permissions, fstab and NixOS. Includes a read-only exercise and my Games/Homelab configuration.

item.title: NixOS rollback: understand generations and undo an update
item.description: Understand NixOS generations: boot an older system, roll back with nixos-rebuild and repair your configuration. Cthulhu provides the concrete example.

item.title: Configure Fastfetch: My Cthulhu system overview step by step
item.description: My Fastfetch configuration explained: screenshot, Kitty image logo, Nerd Fonts, JSONC modules, disks and an age counter. Start with a small local test file.

item.title: Configure Waybar: A clear status bar for Sway
item.description: Waybar for beginners: understand my Sway bar, separate JSONC from CSS, preview a small configuration and add a clock, volume and CPU display.

item.title: Gruvnode: My simple XMonad desktop from the T480 to the X1 Carbon
item.description: Gruvnode explained: from a Debian T480 to an Arch X1 Carbon. Understand the installer, XMonad, Xmobar, audio, Wi-Fi, configuration backups and first startup.

item.title: NixOS for beginners: My configuration.nix explained
item.description: Understand NixOS through my configuration.nix: packages, services, Plasma, PipeWire and hardware, with a small change you can build, test and undo.

item.title: Sway for beginners: My Wayland configuration explained
item.description: Learn Sway through my configuration: variables, two monitors, workspaces, keybindings and window rules, with a small change you can validate and undo.

item.title: Understanding XMonad: My xmonad.hs step by step
item.description: Understand my xmonad.hs: the Super key, Tall and Full layouts, keybindings and hooks, then compile, restart and undo a small configuration change.
